issues.display_title: Issue #4301: fix(i18n): audit locales and achieve 100% translation key parity across all 18 languages
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Audit all locale definitions (src/locales/*.json) to achieve 100% translation key parity across all 18 supported languages, replace hardcoded UI strings with proper translation keys, and clean up orphan/duplicate keys.

Scope

  1. Replace Hardcoded UI Strings: Map raw strings in PublishButton, LimitPreviewModal, AssosiatedPlaceID, and Support components (ChangeStatusPhotographerModal, ReviewPhotographerModal, FeaturedPhotographers) to proper i18n keys.
  2. Translation Parity (18 Locales): Sync all 61+ missing/new keys across all 17 non-EN locales (ba, cs, da, de, es, fr, hi, it, jp, nl, pl, pt, ro, ru, sk, sv, zh).
  3. Cleanup: Remove redundant root t_tour_exist_modal and orphan keys across locale files.

RESULT

Branch: fix/i18n-translations-parity
PR: #4300 (Merged)

  • 100% Parity Across 18 Locales: Synced all 2,427 translation keys across all language files.
  • Replaced Hardcoded UI Strings: Converted raw strings in Publish, Limit Preview, Associated PlaceIDs, and Featured Photographers Support pages to structured i18n keys.
  • Cleaned up Duplicates & Orphans: Removed redundant root t_tour_exist_modal and isolated locale keys.
  • Verification: 75 Jest test suites (528 tests), 24 Playwright E2E tests, and ESLint/Prettier passed.

issues.display_title: Issue #4298: feat(tour): integrate v2 batch archive API with background worker delegation
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate the new POST /v2/tours/batch/archive API into the Archive Tour modal (ArchiveTour.jsx). In V2, heavy validations (ownership, active overlay, physical pano file validation, GSV status, duplicate twin tours) are delegated to an asynchronous background RabbitMQ worker, returning a fast 202 Accepted response.

Background

  • Corresponds to BE endpoint GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1865 (merged via PR GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1866).
  • V1 synchronously validated all panoramas and DB records per tour, causing HTTP timeouts on large batches.
  • V2 enqueues the batch and returns { statusCode: 202, data: { messages: "...", queued: true, count: N, moderation_ids: [...] } }.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Point endpoint in ArchiveTour.jsx to /v2/tours/batch/archive.
  2. Do not show itemized result popup (AfterBatchActionPopup) since validation is deferred to the background worker. The Archive Tour modal already informs the user that the process runs in the background and results/ZIP will be emailed.
  3. Show confirmation / success feedback directly in the modal (or standard toast) on 202 Accepted response, then close cleanly and trigger tour list refresh.
  4. Support single-tour, multi-tour, and type_select: 'all' selection modes seamlessly.
  5. Update unit tests for ArchiveTour to reflect the V2 response contract.

Result

issues.display_title: Issue #4285: feat(tour): Integrate related-by-cid API for same-CID warning on Archive Tour modal
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate the new related-by-cid API into the Archive Tour modal (ArchiveTour.jsx) so the same-CID warning + related tours table renders with real data. Until the endpoint is ready, the related tours are static, passed via the relatedTours prop.

Background

Branch design/dashboard-archive-tour-revision already ships the UI: yellow warning box + collapsible table (Tour Name / CID / Total Panorama). Related tours currently come in statically through the relatedTours prop — no data fetching on the FE yet. A dedicated BE endpoint is being built (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1874); it returns the same-CID tours that will also be archived by the external archive cascade worker (the endpoint itself performs no archiving).

Tasks

  1. When the BE endpoint is ready, fetch related tours when the modal opens, using the existing archive payload (getArchivePayload(): type_select, moderationIds, exceptionIds) as the request body — no new payload building.
  2. Render the warning/table purely from the API response (BE already excludes the tours being directly archived; the returned same-CID tours will also be archived by the external cascade worker); keep the relatedTours prop for testing/demo overrides.
  3. Fail-open on fetch error: hide the warning/table, never block the archive action.

BE Endpoint (contract)

See GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1874 — response shape per item: moderation_id, business_name, cid, total_panorama.

Acceptance

  • Single tour with related same-CID tours → warning expanded, table filled
  • Multi-tour select → warning collapsed by default
  • Select-all path (type_select: "all") works with exceptionIds
  • Empty response → warning/table hidden
  • Fetch failure → archive flow unaffected
  • Related tours table is scrollable when there are many rows — max ~6 items visible before scrolling (container max-h + overflow-y-auto), with a visible scrollbar affordance

Result
